definitions.average: Unique cards weighted by past MIN, full league; measurement/profile rates pooled from past boxes.
definitions.real: Unchanged effective v3 attributes after frozen league calibration; weak/strong selection proxies, not literal zero or all top95.
definitions.synthetic: In-memory average-card clones. No saved card altered. Measured volume/steal/shot profiles unchanged except explicit threeRate=0. Scalar attribute sums are not OVR.
definitions.complement: Column sums equal flat; stacked has exact same multiset per attribute as complement. No claim of equal nonlinear OVR.
definitions.signalMean: Synthetic IDs assigned centers so effect=0; real IDs retain their signals in frozen-v3 control.
definitions.efficiency: Primary actual engine possessions; secondary FGA-OREB+TOV+.44FTA proxy. Shot shares recorded FGA. TOV/actual-possession.
definitions.CI: Paired Monte Carlo delta-method95% over2000 common seeds; not franchise/NBA-validation uncertainty. No tuning/reselection after outcomes.
